items.author: IIICapital
items.context: IIICapital: dice que no cree que los retornos de Bitcoin sigan disminuyendo; que BTC puede seguir su power law por años y luego romper al alza; video con «el camino a $11 millones por Bitcoin».
items.suggested_text: A power law already has diminishing returns built in: the % gains shrink each cycle even if the trend holds. Breaking to the upside would mean leaving the model, not confirming it. Models aren't guarantees, so I track where price sits vs the trend rather than a target. My projection to 2050: https://x.com/forecastquant/status/2119169301949141264

items.author: RGB_Bitcoin
items.context: RGB_Bitcoin: comparte el resumen de Bitfinex sobre hackeos y exploits del año; dice que, aunque la autocustodia sea atacada, sigue siendo el modelo correcto; recuerda generar la semilla con suficiente entropía y respaldar.
items.suggested_text: Agreed, and entropy is the step most people skip. If the seed is generated on a device that touches the internet, everything after inherits that risk. I wrote a book on building your own air-gapped setup without relying on exchanges or commercial hardware wallets, free on Kindle until Wednesday (today): https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HQ5NS31N?dplnkId=c09ef739-11f3-4c76-8c62-92ce160a3341&nodl=1

items.author: glassnode
items.context: glassnode: Bitcoin viene bajando y la oferta de stablecoins se contrae rápido, la contracción más rápida desde junio de 2022; nuevo informe Week On-chain (costo base, flujos de ETF, acumulación).
items.suggested_text: Shrinking stablecoin supply means less dry powder waiting on the sidelines, which fits a slow grind better than a sharp bounce. Do you read it as capital leaving crypto or just moving elsewhere? Curious how it lines up with the ETF flows in the report.

items.author: milkroaddaily
items.context: milkroaddaily: Bitcoin cae hacia $73K; cita a @TimWarrenTrades, que ve una repetición del inicio de 2023 (romper la tendencia bajista, recuperar la media de 200 días y retestear soporte) y dice estar «90%…» (texto cortado).
items.suggested_text: A 2023 rhyme is possible, but the setup only confirms if the 200-day holds on the retest. Breaking a trendline is the easy part. What level invalidates the call? That's what I'd watch more than the 90%.

items.author: CryptoAttackDao
items.context: CryptoAttackDao: frente al pánico por la caída, dice que todos los bear markets de Bitcoin tardaron 12 a 13 meses desde el pico del ciclo hasta el piso final, con una tabla desde 2013.
items.suggested_text: Peak-to-bottom timing has been consistent, but it's a handful of cycles, so it's a pattern, not a rule. Are you dating this cycle's peak from the ATH close or the intraday high? That alone shifts the 12-13 month window by weeks.
